ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the PD 1416,
Planned Development District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-F in the
area bound by:

West Concord Place; the west right-of-way line of the Chicago Transit Authority rail line;
West North Avenue; and North Halsted Street,

to those of an B3-5, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Patrick Murphey
Zoning Administrator

Common Address:
1601 — 1611 N. Halsted St.
744-758 W. North Ave.
